1: # Tasks: upstream-package-monitoring
2: 
3: > Implementation tasks for the `upstream-package-monitoring`
4: > OpenSpec change. Each task is small, testable, and traceable
5: > to a `## Requirements` block in `proposal.md`.
6: 
7: ## 1. BAML schema additions
8: 
9: - [ ] 1.1 Create
10:   `sruth/sruth/oideachais/baml_src/upstream_monitoring.baml` with 3
11:   extraction functions and their Pydantic-style classes:
12:   - [ ] 1.1.1 `ExtractBlogPostMetadata(content: string, url: string) -> BlogPostMetadata`
13:     with fields `(title, author, published_at: datetime, package: enum, blog_post_type: enum, summary: string, affected_capabilities: list[string], code_examples: list[string], api_changes: list[string])`
14:   - [ ] 1.1.2 `ExtractCocoIndexApiChange(content: string, url: string) -> ApiChange`
15:     with fields `(symbol: string, old_signature: string, new_signature: string, severity: enum[BREAKING|MAJOR|MINOR|PATCH], migration_steps: list[string], example_code: string, changelog_url: string)`
16:   - [ ] 1.1.3 `ExtractPackageRelease(content: string, url: string) -> PackageRelease`
17:     with fields `(package: enum, version: string, release_date: datetime, breaking_changes: list[string], new_features: list[string], deprecations: list[string])`
18:   - [ ] 1.1.4 All 3 route through the canonical `ExtractEn`
19:     client from `sruth/sruth/oideachais/baml_src/clients.baml:243-251`
20: - [ ] 1.2 Run `mise run baml:generate` (or `cd sruth/oideachais
21:   && uv run baml-cli generate`) and verify
22:   `baml_client/upstream_monitoring.py` is created.
23: - [ ] 1.3 Confirm the new file is auto-picked-up by
24:   `baml_src/__init__.py` (no manual re-export needed if
25:   BAML glob includes `**/*.baml`).
26: 
27: ## 2. CocoIndex v1 App: upstream blog monitor
28: 
29: - [ ] 2.1 Create
30:   `sruth/sruth/oideachais/cocoindex_flows/upstream_blog_monitor.py`
31:   with:
32:   - [ ] 2.1.1 Imports `shared_lifespan`, `LANCE_DB`, `EMBEDDER`,
33:     `RESOLVED_FILE_REGISTRY`, `LANCEDB_URI`, `EMBED_MODEL`,
34:     `EMBED_DIM` from `oideachais.cocoindex_flows._lifespan`.
35:     **No new ContextKeys declared** (R2 conformance rule).
36:   - [ ] 2.1.2 `@coco.lifespan` that wraps `shared_lifespan`
37:     and additionally provides a `KG_DB_UPSTREAM` ContextKey
38:     (`detect_change=False`) bound to a FalkorDB connection
39:     selected on graph `upstream_packages_graph`. The
40:     `KG_DB_UPSTREAM` ContextKey is exempt from R2 (declared in
41:     `tasks.md:§ 8`).
42:   - [ ] 2.1.3 `app_main` that mounts
43:     `localfs.walk_dir("stedding/upstream_blog_payloads/",
44:     recursive=True, live=True, refresh_interval=120s)` where
45:     `stedding/upstream_blog_payloads/` is the local mirror
46:     populated by the n8n workflow.
47:   - [ ] 2.1.4 Phase 1 `@coco.fn(memo=True) process_blog_payload`
48:     that runs `ExtractBlogPostMetadata` and emits an
49:     `UpstreamBlogChunk` dataclass row.
50:   - [ ] 2.1.5 Phase 2 `@coco.fn build_blog_graph` that declares
51:     `BlogPostNode` + `PackageNode` + `CapabilityNode` nodes
52:     and `PUBLISHED_BY` / `AFFECTS_CAPABILITY` /
53:     `MENTIONS_PACKAGE` edges into the
54:     `upstream_packages_graph` FalkorDB graph.
55:   - [ ] 2.1.6 LanceDB target `upstream_blog_chunks` with HNSW
56:     on `embedding` (vector_dim=1024, hnsw_drop_threshold=50).
57:   - [ ] 2.1.7
58:     `app = coco.App(coco.AppConfig(name="UpstreamBlogMonitor"),
59:     app_main)` at module level (R3 conformance rule).

61: ## 3. CocoIndex v1 App: cocoindex v1 conformance
62: 
63: - [ ] 3.1 Create
64:   `sruth/sruth/oideachais/cocoindex_flows/cocoindex_v1_conformance.py`
65:   with:
66:   - [ ] 3.1.1 Imports `shared_lifespan` from
67:     `oideachais.cocoindex_flows._lifespan` (R1 conformance rule).
68:   - [ ] 3.1.2 A `ConformanceReport` dataclass
69:     `(app_name, r1_pass, r2_pass, r3_pass, r4_pass,
70:     violations: list[str], checked_at: datetime)`.
71:   - [ ] 3.1.3 A `run_conformance_check(repo_root: pathlib.Path)
72:     -> ConformanceReport` function that walks every
73:     `sruth/sruth/oideachais/cocoindex_flows/*.py` file (except
74:     `__init__.py`, `_lifespan.py`, `_v0_archive/`) and applies
75:     the 4 rules:
76:     - **R1**: AST contains `from ._lifespan import` AND
77:       `shared_lifespan` referenced
78:     - **R2**: no `coco.ContextKey[` declaration outside
79:       `_lifespan.py` AND any `coco.ContextKey[` declaration
80:       in the file has a sibling `# R2-exempt: <reason>` comment
81:     - **R3**: AST contains `coco.App(coco.AppConfig(`
82:     - **R4**: AST contains `@coco.fn(`
83:   - [ ] 3.1.4
84:     `app = coco.App(coco.AppConfig(name="CocoIndexV1Conformance"),
85:     app_main)` at module level. The `app_main` reads the
86:     `ConformanceReport` from a sibling asset and re-runs the
87:     check on every change to `cocoindex_flows/*.py`.
88:

102:   - [ ] 4.1.3 `app_main` mounts the 4 cocoindex docs URLs

108:   - [ ] 4.1.5 Phase 2 `@coco.fn build_api_change_graph` that

112:   - [ ] 4.1.6 LanceDB target `upstream_api_chunks` with HNSW.
113:   - [ ] 4.1.7
114:     `app = coco.App(coco.AppConfig(name="UpstreamApiSurface"),
115:     app_main)` at module level.
